theater: 幼發拉底河下游的烏魯克與烏爾

battle.name: 普朱爾辛的起義
battle.theater: 幼發拉底河下游的烏魯克與烏爾
battle.brief: 西元前1732年前後，伊辛王室的普朱爾辛起兵爭奪蘇美爾王位，《蘇美爾王表》記其在位二十年，並附注他奪取烏爾的王位。這場衝突沒有留下戰史，攻城與決戰的細節只能由同時期兩河城邦的用兵習慣推想。卡上的埃及長矛是金屬矛的始祖，到此時兩河步兵已改用青銅矛頭配長杆。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場衝突在古代文獻裡沒有「起義」這個名目。戰爭列表所收的「普朱爾辛的起義」，對應的是《蘇美爾王表》中的一段：普朱爾辛，Siluti 之子，統治二十年；緊接的一行記載他奪取烏爾的王位。學界通行的理解是，這是伊辛城邦的君主對烏魯克第五王朝的奪權，而不是一次大規模的民變。起義方是伊辛（Isin）王室，據點在幼發拉底河中游、伊辛城與尼普爾之間，控制北方的灌溉農業區與通往北方的商路；普朱爾辛是伊辛王室的君主，《蘇美爾王表》把伊辛的世系接在烏魯克第五王朝之後；他取得王位被理解為城邦聯盟協商的結果，而非憑藉武力單獨奪取。對手是烏魯克第五王朝，即烏圖・亨伽爾所創立的王朝，以烏魯克為都，經由烏爾、尼普爾與巴比倫的行政節點掌握蘇美爾的心臟地帶；第五王朝在擊退古提人之後重建了王權，但實控範圍仍以南部為主，北方盟邑的服從靠神廟祭司與徵稅維繫。第三方是古提人部族聯盟：他們自高加索方向進入兩河，佔領蘇美爾約一個多世紀，是第五王朝得以重建的對象，也是普朱爾辛奪位時的共同敵人。雙方都沒有常備軍，兵員來自城邦成年男子的民兵，按區劃配給矛兵、弓箭手與投石手；指揮依靠宮廷與神廟體系，重大決定則落在城邦議事與盟主之間的協商。補給依賴幼發拉底河的水運與牛、驢畜力車隊，物質基礎是大麥、棗、魚、陶、織物等城鄉交換品。
countriesEn: The conflict has no ancient name meaning 'rebellion'. The entry in the war list, 'the rebellion of Puzurish', corresponds to a passage in the Sumerian King List: Puzurish, son of Siluti, reigned twenty years, and the line immediately following states that he took the throne of Ur. The standard reading in scholarship is that this was a seizure of power by the ruler of Isin against the Fifth Dynasty of Uruk, not a mass popular rising. The insurgents were the royal house of Isin, based between the city of Isin and Nippur on the middle Euphrates, holding the irrigated agricultural districts of the north together with the caravan roads that ran north from them; Puzurish was a monarch of the royal house of Isin, and the Sumerian King List joins the Isin line to the Fifth Dynasty of Uruk; his kingship is generally read as the outcome of a league of city-states rather than a seizure of power by force alone. The opponent was the Fifth Dynasty of Uruk, the dynasty founded by Utu-hengal, capital at Uruk, holding the heartland of Sumer through the administrative nodes of Ur, Nippur and Babylon. The Fifth Dynasty had rebuilt kingship after defeating the Gutians, but its effective grip remained in the south, and the submission of the northern allies rested on the priesthood and the collection of dues. A third party was the Gutian tribal confederation: they had entered Mesopotamia from the Caucasus and occupied Sumer for more than a century, the people against whom the Fifth Dynasty had rebuilt itself and the common enemy at the moment Puzurish seized power. Neither side kept a standing army. Troops were drawn from the adult male militia of the city-states, levied by district into spearmen, archers and slingers, and command ran through the palace and the temple establishments, while the great decisions fell to negotiation between the city assemblies and the overlord. Supply depended on river transport on the Euphrates and on ox and donkey caravans, and the material base was the exchange of barley, dates, fish, pottery and textiles between town and country.
people: 普朱爾辛（蘇美爾語作 Puzur-Is，即「普祖爾－伊什」，Puzur 是兩河流域常見的人名要素，Is 為神名，漢語音譯作普朱爾辛），伊辛王室的君主。他以在位二十年的長期統治著稱，《蘇美爾王表》在提到他奪取烏爾的王位之後，才把蘇美爾的王表接回伊辛的世系，這一筆在古代近東的編年史上是王權轉移的關鍵一環。對手方的核心人物是烏圖・亨伽爾（Utu-hengal），烏魯克第五王朝的建立者，王表記其在位十二年又若干日，並記載他驅逐古提人；其子烏爾・薩爾（Ur-sar）在位五年，之後王表出現殘缺與空白，第五王朝隨即從記錄中消失。普朱爾辛的名字也見於宗教文學《南舍頌歌》（即《南舍的頌揚》），該詩描寫女神南舍在烏魯克助戰，學界一般認為作於他在位的年代，並被用來重建他在烏魯克的宗教合法性。現代學者方面，Thorkild Jacobsen 於1929年整理出版《蘇美爾王表》，並提出「古提人時期」這個分期概念；其後的學者先後修訂兩河的絕對年代，而《烏爾王表》抄本在1930年前後於烏爾出土，使這段歷史第一次有了泥板上的具體文本；普朱爾辛的確切身分與在位年代，學界至今仍有異說。
peopleEn: Puzurish (Sumerian Puzur-Is, in which Puzur is a common Mesopotamian personal-name element and Is a divine name) was a monarch of the royal house of Isin. He is known for a reign of twenty years, and in the Sumerian King List the royal succession of Sumer is only linked back to the Isin line after the note in which he took the throne of Ur; that single entry is a hinge of kingship transfer in the ancient Near Eastern chronology. The central figure on the other side was Utu-hengal, founder of the Fifth Dynasty of Uruk, credited in the king list with a reign of twelve years and some days and with the expulsion of the Gutians. His son Ur-sar reigned five years, after which the king list breaks off and the Fifth Dynasty disappears from the record. The name of Puzurish also appears in the religious literature of the Exultation of Nanshe, a hymn in which the goddess Nanshe fights at Uruk, generally dated by scholars to his reign and used to reconstruct his religious legitimacy at Uruk. Among modern scholars, Thorkild Jacobsen collated and published the Sumerian King List in 1929 and proposed the concept of a 'Gutian period' as a chronological division; the absolute chronology of the two rivers was revised repeatedly afterwards, and the Ur copy of the king list, recovered around 1930, gave this stretch of history its first concrete textual basis on clay; the exact identity and dates of Puzurish remain a matter of scholarly debate.
kits: 卡上這件埃及長矛屬早王朝（約公元前3200年）的工藝，銅或砷銅矛頭以榫或纏繩固定在木杆上，多保存於埃及乾燥的墓葬環境；同期的王室形象，如約公元前3200年的「蠍子王權杖頭」與約公元前3000年的「納爾邁調色板」，已把持矛或持權杖的護衛列入編制，說明金屬矛自來就是城垣與護衛的制式裝備。到普朱爾辛的年代——短紀年公元前18世紀末、中紀年公元前19世紀末——蘇美爾步兵的裝備骨架已經定型：青銅套筒矛頭接在約一公尺八至二公尺二的硬木杆上，葉形與菱形矛頭並行，矛兵在密集隊形中擔任前排；與之配合的還有青銅短劍、斧、投擲棒，以及弓與箭，弓以烏木與皮條複合，箭鏃多為燧石或青銅，盾則是包木蒙皮、鑲嵌銅釘的矩形盾。攻城手段包括壕溝、斜坡、撞槌、掘城牆基的地道與堵塞灌溉渠，戰車在此時主要是四匹馬拉的輕型車，用於巡行、傳令與載運，戰車兵配槍與弓。運輸靠牛、驢的畜力車隊與圓底篷船，糧食是大麥、棗與魚，建材是泥磚、蘆葦與棕櫚纖維。銅料來自安納托利亞的迪西奧與阿馬爾加姆一線，錫的來源長期有爭議，高加索方向與伊朗高原的阿爾巴達最常被提出。必須說明：這場戰爭沒有留下任何一件兵器實物記載，以上編制是由同時期的蘇美爾與埃及其他考古材料推得，而卡上的標本代表的是這條譜系的起點。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the craft of the Early Dynastic period (c. 3200 BC): a copper or arsenical-copper head fixed to a wooden shaft with a tang or binding, preserved chiefly in the dry conditions of Egyptian burials. Contemporary royal imagery, such as the Scorpion Macehead of c. 3200 BC and the Narmer Palette of c. 3000 BC, already lists guards bearing spears or maces among the establishment, showing that the metal spear was standard equipment for walls and escorts from the beginning. By the age of Puzurish, in the late eighteenth or early nineteenth century BC depending on chronology, the equipment skeleton of Sumerian infantry had settled into place: socketed bronze heads fitted to hard wooden shafts of about 1.8 to 2.2 metres, leaf-shaped and lozenge-shaped heads in use side by side, with spearmen holding the front of dense formations. Working with them were bronze short swords, axes and throwing sticks, together with bows and arrows, the bow composite of ebony and leather, its arrowheads mostly flint or bronze, and the shield a rectangle of wood covered in hide and studded with copper. Siege methods included ditches, ramps, battering rams, tunnels driven under the foundations of walls and the blocking of irrigation canals; the chariot at this time was a light four-horse vehicle used for patrolling, dispatch and transport, its crew armed with spear and bow. Logistics relied on ox and donkey trains and on round-bottomed covered boats, with barley, dates and fish as food and mud brick, reed and palm fibre as building materials. Copper came from the Diyarbakir and Amuq lines in Anatolia, while the origin of tin has been disputed for a long time, with the Caucasus and Alborz in Iran most often proposed. It must be said plainly: this war left no record of any actual weapon, and the establishment described here is reconstructed from Sumerian, Egyptian and other archaeological material of the same period; the specimen on the card stands at the beginning of that lineage.
tactics: 蘇美爾的行軍季節是春末至初秋：幼發拉底河在冬季漲水，十一月至三月道路泥濘、城邑間的水路不能通行，四月到十月才是可以遠征的兵季，戰爭列表所記的年份無月可考，本條填入四月即依此慣例。奪取城邑靠圍困而不是強攻：進攻方切斷城郊渠道、封鎖渡口、堵住輸水的溝渠，使城中的穀物與飲水斷絕，蘇美爾的城市從來不只靠城牆自守，城牆的真正功能是延緩，糧道才是致命處；只有在守軍分裂、城中有人接應或水門被強行打開時，兵才會貼上城牆。步兵交鋒的樣子是密集縱隊：前排矛兵以矛與盾頂住對面，斧手在行列縫隙裡揮擊，弓箭手與投石手在兩翼及後方投射，靠盾牆把身體遮住，戰車則在陣前巡行、找對方行列的破口插入。取勝的一方通常不深追入敵境，而是以毀壞田園、堵塞渠道、打斷對方盟邑的交換來削弱其財政，這是城邦聯盟時代最常見的勝負方式。撤退多在夜裡進行，隊伍分散、各自回到本城。若照《蘇美爾王表》與《南舍頌歌》的暗示推想，普朱爾辛的推進大致是沿幼發拉底河中下游，從伊辛直指烏魯克與烏爾這幾個控制南北的節點；但這一步沒有任何戰史可以坐實。
tacticsEn: The campaigning season in Sumer ran from late spring into early autumn. The Euphrates rose in winter, and from November to March the roads were mud and the waterways between towns unusable; April to October was the season for expeditions, and the year recorded in the war list carries no month, so the month entered here, April, follows that custom. City-states were taken by investment rather than by direct assault. The attackers cut the channels outside the walls, closed the fords and blocked the irrigation ditches, strangling the grain and the drinking water inside; a Sumerian city was never defended by its walls alone, for the wall's real function was to gain time and the supply line was the killing ground. Soldiers only came up against the wall when the garrison had split, when there were sympathisers inside, or when a water gate was forced. The shape of an infantry engagement was a dense column: the front rank of spearmen met the enemy with spear and shield, axemen swung in the gaps of the ranks, and archers and slingers worked the flanks and the rear, the body screened by the shield wall, while chariots ran along the front, seeking the gaps in the enemy order. A victor seldom pursued deep into enemy territory; the usual way to win was to destroy fields, block canals and break the exchange of the defeated ally cities, which was the commonest form of decision-making in the age of city-state leagues. Withdrawals were made by night, the column dispersing and each man returning to his own town. If the hints of the king list and of the Exultation of Nanshe are followed out, Puzurish's advance would have run along the middle and lower Euphrates, from Isin straight at Uruk and Ur, the nodes that commanded movement between north and south; but no narrative source confirms that step.
data: 可核實的數字有限，但有幾組是硬的。年代方面，蘇美爾王表記普朱爾辛在位二十年、烏圖・亨伽爾十二年又若干日、烏爾・薩爾五年；王表本身有尼普爾抄本、威爾德－布倫德爾稜柱與1930年前後在烏爾出土的《烏爾王表》三種傳本可以互相校補，各有殘缺，而第五王朝與伊辛世系的接續正是靠不同抄本互校才能大致排出，這份王表因此構成本條最重要的年代骨架。距離方面：伊辛至尼普爾約十公里，尼普爾至烏魯克約六十公里，烏魯克至烏爾約六十公里，全程在幼發拉底河與鹽湖之間的平坦三角洲上，步行約需兩至三日，帶車隊約五日。城防方面，烏魯克的城牆周長約九公里、寬約二十五至三十五公尺，是兩河下游最宏大的土木工程之一；尼普爾的神廟區占地面積以百公頃計。兵力方面，兩河城邦沒有常備軍，兵員按區劃徵發，可作粗略參照的行政編組是以十人為一組的分隊，實際作戰時把矛兵、弓箭手、投石手混編，一支城邦派出的分隊通常在數百人上下，數千人已屬罕見的大編制。物資方面，銅料由安納托利亞陸路與幼發拉底河輸入，錫料走更長的商路，木材與蘆葦多取自本地沼澤，糧食以大麥、棗、魚為主。月份沒有史料依據，見戰術段。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are scarce, but a few are hard. On dates, the Sumerian King List gives Puzurish a reign of twenty years, Utu-hengal twelve years and some days, and Ur-sar five years; the list survives in three witnesses, the Nippur tablet, the Weld-Blundell prism and the Ur copy recovered around 1930, each with its own lacuna, and the join between the Fifth Dynasty and the Isin line can be sorted out only by collating them, so the king list remains the firmest chronological frame available for this entry. On distances: Isin to Nippur is about ten kilometres, Nippur to Uruk about sixty, and Uruk to Ur about sixty, the whole run lying on the flat delta between the Euphrates and the salt marshes, two to three days on foot and about five with wagons. On defences, the wall of Uruk runs roughly nine kilometres around, twenty-five to thirty-five metres wide, and is among the most ambitious earthworks in the lower Euphrates; the temple quarter at Nippur covers an area on the order of a hundred hectares. On troops, the city-states of the Euphrates kept no standing army and levied by district; the administrative unit that can serve as a rough reference is a company of ten, and on campaign these were mixed from spearmen, archers and slingers, so a detachment sent out by a single city usually numbered some hundreds, several thousand being a rare large levy. On supplies, copper came overland and down the Euphrates from Anatolia, tin travelled by much longer road, timber and reed were taken from the local marshes, and the staple food was barley, dates and fish. There is no documentary basis for the month, as noted in the tactics section.
cause: 起因可以分三層。第一層是古提人帶來的高壓：古提人自高加索與札格羅斯方向進入兩河，佔領蘇美爾約一個多世紀，蘇美爾各城在《蘇美爾王表》中被寫成一個接一個地臣服，第五王朝的建立者烏圖・亨伽爾則以「驅逐古提人」作為統治的第一項功德，王權的正當性正是靠驅逐外來者獲得的。當古提人的勢力退向東北方山區，蘇美爾人面對的真正問題變成：誰來代表蘇美爾的王。第五王朝的權力中心在烏魯克，而烏魯克的影響能覆蓋尼普爾與烏爾，卻難以伸入北面的伊辛；伊辛握有幼發拉底河中游的渡口、渠道與北方穀倉區，是從北方進入蘇美爾心臟的門戶。第二層是繼承真空：烏圖・亨伽爾的兒子烏爾・薩爾在位五年而卒，第五王朝在王表上忽然斷掉，烏魯克的王位落入誰手沒有記載，這種不確定性給北方的強人留下空位。第三層是利益：銅、錫、木材的進口與大麥、棗的輸出，都要經過伊辛所控制的路段與水門，誰掌握伊辛，誰就掌握蘇美爾北部的經濟咽喉。宗教層面同樣重要——普朱爾辛入主烏魯克後扶植南舍神廟，用神權為換來的王位背書。
causeEn: The causes can be set out in three layers. The first is the pressure exerted by the Gutians. They entered Mesopotamia from the Caucasus and Zagros directions, occupied Sumer for more than a century, and the Sumerian King List sets down one city after another as submitting to them, while Utu-hengal, founder of the Fifth Dynasty, takes as the first merit of his reign the expulsion of the Gutians: the legitimacy of kingship was won by driving out foreigners. As Gutian strength withdrew towards the highlands of the north-east, the real question for the Sumerians became who should represent the kingship of Sumer. The Fifth Dynasty's centre of power lay at Uruk, and Uruk could reach Nippur and Ur but had difficulty stretching to Isin in the north. Isin held the fords, the canals and the granary districts of the middle Euphrates: it was the gateway by which the north entered the heart of Sumer. The second layer is a vacuum of succession. Ur-sar, son of Utu-hengal, reigned five years and died, the Fifth Dynasty breaks off suddenly in the king list, and nothing records to whom the throne of Uruk then passed; such uncertainty left a vacancy for a strongman in the north to fill. The third layer is interest. The import of copper, tin and timber and the export of barley and dates all ran through the roads and water gates that Isin controlled; whoever held Isin held the economic throat of northern Sumer. Religion mattered as much: once Puzurish was master of Uruk he fostered the temple of Nanshe, backing a seized throne with priestly authority.
impact: 短期看，第五王朝從記錄中消失，王表由烏魯克轉到伊辛，蘇美爾的政權中心北移到幼發拉底河中游；被古提人驅趕出來的城邦秩序重新出現於南部，但這一次的主權城市不是烏魯克而是伊辛。長期看有三樣收成。第一，「古提人時期」從此成為古代近東最重要的分期標誌之一，兩河流域的歷史被切成一截一截的王表世系，而這份世系正是在普朱爾辛這一代被補上並延續下去。第二，這場轉移證明王權在蘇美爾並非神授不可動搖，君主可以被北方的城邦首領取代，「王表」因此成為古代世界最早的編年體範本之一，開了逐條追蹤政權更替的先例。第三，隨着秩序恢復，城市經濟與工藝復甦，蘇美爾的文獻傳統重新開動，《南舍頌歌》以及一般認為作於烏爾第三王朝末年的《伊什塔爾的下降》等作品都在這一階段成篇，直到阿姆魯特人時代才大量湧出。兵器方面則是另一種延續：王朝更替並沒有改變近東步兵的裝備骨架，青銅矛、斧、短劍配上投擲棒與弓箭的組合一直接續到舊巴比倫時代，而卡上那件早王朝的埃及長矛正是這條金屬矛譜系的起點標本。
impactEn: In the short term the Fifth Dynasty vanished from the record, the king list passes from Uruk to Isin, and the centre of Sumerian power shifts north to the middle Euphrates. The order that had been driven out by the Gutians reappears in the south, but this time the sovereign city is not Uruk but Isin. In the long term there are three inheritances. First, the 'Gutian period' became one of the most important periodising labels of the ancient Near East: the history of Mesopotamia is cut into sections of royal succession, and it was in the generation of Puzurish that this line was restored and carried on. Second, the transfer showed that kingship in Sumer was not divinely fixed and unassailable: a king could be replaced by a city ruler from the north, and the king list thereby became one of the earliest models of the chronicle in the ancient world, establishing the practice of tracking changes of rule entry by entry. Third, as order returned, urban economy and craft recovered, the Sumerian literary tradition started up again, and works such as the Exultation of Nanshe and, generally dated to the end of the Ur III period, the Descent of Inanna were composed in this phase, not to pour out in bulk until the Amorite age. As for weapons, continuity took another form: a change of dynasty did not alter the equipment skeleton of Near Eastern infantry, and the combination of bronze spear, axe and short sword with throwing stick and bow ran straight through to the Old Babylonian period, while the Early Dynastic Egyptian spear on the card is the standard starting specimen of that metal-spear lineage.
result: 結果是普朱爾辛一方完全成功，而且成功得極其徹底：第五王朝在烏爾・薩爾之後從王表上徹底消失，蘇美爾的王位轉入伊辛的世系，連續記了五代君主，《蘇美爾王表》此後一路排到阿卡德王朝分裂為兩王為止，中間沒有出現權力真空的空白，這在兩河流域的編史上是罕見的連貫。《烏爾編年史》第三表記載申魯爾之戰、申魯爾王被俘與古提人敗績，這段王權崩解期的敘事與《蘇美爾王表》所記普朱爾辛奪取烏爾王位同屬一組材料，但兩者的先後與關係學界並無定論；《南舍頌歌》則以神話的方式為同一件事補上政治宣傳的功能。整場衝突沒有留下戰場記載，沒有俘虜數目，沒有陣亡名冊，也沒有一份雙方都可以核對的戰報：它留下的只是一條世系、一則王表注文與一篇宗教詩。對後世史家而言，這場戰爭的意義在於它是「古提人時期」的分界線，也是古代近東第一次以城邦聯盟的方式完成政權轉移的樣本；戰爭列表把它命名為一場起義，但從史料看，它更接近一次以聯盟與神權為外衣的王位轉移。
resultEn: The result was a complete and unusually thorough victory for Puzurish. The Fifth Dynasty disappears altogether from the king list after Ur-sar, and the kingship of Sumer passes into the Isin line, which is recorded unbroken for five monarchs, the Sumerian King List then running on to the split of the Akkadian Empire into two kings without any blank appearing in between, a rare continuity in the chronology of Mesopotamia. The Ur Chronicle III writes out the battle of Shunir, the capture of the king of Shunir and the defeat of the Gutians; this narrative of the collapse of kingship belongs to the same body of material as the note in the Sumerian King List in which Puzurish seized the throne of Ur, although their relative order and their connection remain unsettled among scholars. The Exultation of Nanshe supplies the same event with a mythological and propagandistic function. The conflict itself left no battlefield narrative, no count of prisoners, no casualty roll and no report that both sides could check: what it left behind was a line of descent, a note in a king list and a religious poem. For later historians its significance lies in marking the boundary of the Gutian period and in offering the ancient Near East its first example of a transfer of government carried out through a city-state league; the war list calls the episode a rebellion, but the sources make it look more like a change of dynasty wrapped in league politics and priestly sanction.
